title: OKDP platform values
description: The settings of global.okdp the OKDP compiler reads, given by the context's values layers, the platform's at level 0 (okdp-compile --context, Inputs.Context). Every compile checks them, in every mode, and reports every violation at once; it applies the defaults. Only the settings the compiler reads are described: any other key is allowed (ingress.className, project...), and every key reaches the mapping as written (global.okdp) and every chart (global). As in a chart's values, a null deletes a setting's default, and is refused where there is none; an empty string is a value.

suffix.description: The domain of the platform's hosts: ${suffix} of the contracts' x-okdp-internal fields, the hosts of internal connection references and of provided outputs.

name.description: The cert-manager issuer of the services' certificates: platform.ingressAnnotations, cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer.

charts.description: The upstream charts that render the charts the compiler adds itself, each a repository, a chart and its version. Each is checked after the requirements as a dependency of Chart.yaml is: a repository URL, the name of a chart, a pinned version.

objects.description: The chart of OKDP's own objects, the okdp chart: an okdp-objects chart (values objects: [], each item printed as one YAML document). Required.

repository.description: The URL of the chart repository: https://, http:// or oci://.

chart.description: The name of the chart in the repository.

version.description: A pinned version (1.2.3), not a range.

oidcDcr.description: The chart of the OAuth clients in dcr mode: an oidc-dcr chart that takes the values of oidc-dcr 0.5.0, which the compiler writes. Absent: oci://quay.io/adaltas, oidc-dcr, 0.5.0.

repository.description: The URL of the chart repository: https://, http:// or oci://.

chart.description: The name of the chart in the repository.

version.description: A pinned version (1.2.3), not a range.

oidc.description: The platform's identity provider, and how the services' OAuth clients are provisioned. The mapping sees it as platform.oidc, defaults applied, with existing and dcr.enabled, the mode in effect.

enabled.description: Whether the services use OIDC. A null deletes the default: OIDC is off, and platform.oidc.enabled is absent.

clientProvisioning.description: How the services' OAuth clients are provisioned. existing: by the platform, each client's Secret creds-<release>-oauth2[-<name>]. dcr: each registered by dynamic client registration, by the Job of an oidc-dcr chart the compiler adds, its Secret <release>-<namespace>[-<name>]-dcr.

scope.description: The scope a client registers in dcr mode when it sets none (openid left out).

issuerUri.description: The provider's issuer URL: the oidc-dcr Jobs wait for its discovery document, <issuerUri>/.well-known/openid-configuration (waitForProvider.discoveryUrl).

dcr.description: The settings of the oidc-dcr Jobs that register the OAuth clients in dcr mode: the values of the client charts. The mapping sees them as platform.oidc.dcr, defaults applied.

registrationUrl.description: The registration endpoint the Jobs register the clients at (registrationUrl). Required, a non-empty string, in dcr mode when a service declares a client: checked then only.

authMethod.description: How the Jobs authenticate to the registration endpoint: anonymous, the only method OKDP supports. Required in dcr mode when a service declares a client: checked then only.

image.description: The Jobs' image (registry, repository, tag, pullPolicy, pullSecrets), merged over the chart's: the camelCase keys of oidc-dcr >= 0.5.0, the snake_case keys of an earlier version, pull_policy and pull_secrets, refused. Absent: the chart's.

caSecret.description: The Secret holding the CA bundle the Jobs trust (tls.certificate); a client's caSecret wins.

ttlSeconds.description: How long a finished Job, and its logs, is kept, in seconds (ttlSeconds).

waitTtlSeconds.description: The longest wait for the provider's discovery document, in seconds (waitForProvider.ttlSeconds); the Jobs wait only when oidc.issuerUri is set. Absent: the chart's, 600.

proxy.description: The platform's proxy: platform.proxyEnv, the environment variables of each setting that is not empty.
